html:
Custom Sprinter Camper Van Conversions by Abroga Vans

Looking for a custom Sprinter camper van conversion designed for off-grid adventures and built to the highest standards? At Abroga Vans, we specialize in transforming Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans into self-sufficient, functional homes on wheels, crafted for durability and comfort no matter where your journey takes you.

Why Choose a Custom Sprinter Camper Van Conversion?

The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter is the ideal platform for camper conversions thanks to its reliability, cargo space, and versatile chassis options. Custom conversions allow you to tailor every inch, from layout and cabinetry to electrical systems and plumbing, so your van perfectly fits your travel style and needs.

Our bespoke conversions focus on off-grid capability, with marine-grade 12V electrical systems, durable cabinetry, and climate controls suited for four-season travel.

Key Decisions When Planning Your Sprinter Conversion

1. Layout and Interior Design

Every conversion begins with a consultation and custom 3D CAD layout design. This step ensures your camper van’s floor plan matches how you travel, sleep, cook, and store gear. Whether you want a minimal galley or a full indoor wet bath and shower, your layout is professionally planned to maximize space and comfort.

Learn more about our detailed Build Specs.

2. Electrical and Off-Grid Systems

Power your adventures off the grid with smart lithium battery banks (ranging from 250Ah to 750Ah), solar arrays, and shore power hookups. A build can also include a Xantrex inverter. We use marine-grade wiring harnesses and advanced components to ensure reliable, continuous power for lighting, refrigeration, cooking, and heating.

3. Climate Control and Water Solutions

Travel comfortably year-round with sealed diesel heaters, winterized plumbing, filtered water manifolds, and optional hot water systems. These systems enable you to camp in cold or hot climates without sacrificing comfort.

4. Cabinetry and Build Quality

Our craftsmanship uses furniture-grade cabinetry, lightweight structural framing, and commercial-grade hardware designed to withstand the vibration and wear of long-term travel. The build is made like equipment, not furniture, for longevity and function.

5. Conversion Packages and Pricing

We offer transparent build tiers to fit different lifestyles and budgets:

  • The Weekender (~$20,000): Ideal for minimalists and weekend warriors; includes 250Ah lithium battery bank, premium insulation, and kitchen galley.
  • The Explorer (~$25,000): Upgraded power with 500Ah battery bank, integrated plumbing, induction cooktop, and sound deadening.
  • The Basecamp (~$35,000): Full-time and luxury travelers’ choice; 750Ah battery, hot water system, wet bath/shower, and advanced heating options.

Final pricing is locked after the CAD layout phase for full transparency.

Check detailed Pricing and explore Past Builds to see what’s possible.

6. Build Process and Timeline

Our conversion process is fully documented and divided into four clear phases:

  • Consult & CAD layout design
  • Component sourcing at wholesale prices
  • Professional fabrication and wiring installation
  • Handoff with system training and detailed documentation

Learn about the full Process.

7. How to Start Your Custom Build

We accept a limited number of builds annually to maintain quality and focus on each project. Begin by submitting your build request, including budget, timeline, and van ownership status, through our intake form.

Get started here: Start Your Build.

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes a Sprinter van the preferred platform for camper conversions?

The Sprinter offers excellent cargo space, high roof options, reliability, and efficient diesel engine choices. These traits provide a solid foundation for versatile, comfortable custom camper vans suited for extensive travel.

How long does a custom Sprinter van conversion typically take?

From consultation to final handoff, most projects follow a four-phase process that can vary depending on build complexity and current shop queue. You will receive updates and a detailed timeline during the quote and planning stages.

Can I customize the electrical system for off-grid living?

Absolutely. Abroga Vans specializes in marine-grade 12V electrical systems with smart lithium battery banks, solar setups, and inverters designed to keep you powered anywhere without relying on campgrounds.

What is included in the build price tiers?

The pricing tiers, from The Weekender to The Basecamp, offer increasing levels of battery capacity, off-grid features, cabinetry, and climate control systems to match your travel goals and budget.

Can you help me find a Mercedes Sprinter van if I don't own one?

Yes, we offer build planning, and we can help you search for the right van before conversion begins. You buy the van yourself.

Ready to transform your Sprinter van into a custom off-grid camper built for the long haul? Start Your Build today and get a detailed consultation and quote from Abroga Vans, crafted in East Greenville, PA for travelers across the US.
